overview: A minimal single-page web application that serves a static 'Hello World' message to visitors. The architecture consists of a single frontend component that renders the greeting directly in the browser without requiring backend services or data persistence.
requirements: The application must display 'Hello World' text when accessed in a web browser
The application must be accessible via HTTP/HTTPS
The application must provide a /health endpoint for monitoring
The application must load and render within 3 seconds
The application must be responsive and work on desktop and mobile browsers

components.name: hello-world-app
components.openAPISpec:
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Hello World Web Application
  version: 1.0.0
  description: A simple web application that displays Hello World
paths:
  /health:
    get:
      summary: Health check endpoint
      operationId: healthCheck
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Application is healthy
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  status:
                    type: string
                    example: ok
components.componentAgentInstructions: Implement a React-based single-page application using TypeScript and Vite as the build tool. Create a simple component that renders 'Hello World' in a centered div with clean typography. Use React 18+ with functional components. The app should include: 1) A main App.tsx component that displays 'Hello World' centered on the page with appropriate styling (use CSS modules or inline styles). 2) A /health endpoint served by the Vite dev server or implemented via a simple Express server for production builds that returns {status: 'ok'} with 200 status code. 3) Dockerfile that uses node:18-alpine as base, installs dependencies with npm ci, builds the production bundle with npm run build, and serves it using a lightweight HTTP server like serve or nginx on port 8080. 4) Package.json with scripts for dev, build, and start. 5) Basic responsive styling so the text is readable on mobile and desktop. 6) Minimal HTML template (index.html) that loads the React app. The component should be simple - no routing, no state management, no external API calls. Focus on clean code structure and a working Dockerfile. Environment: Node.js 18+, React 18+, TypeScript 5+, Vite 4+. Port: 8080 for production server.
